steps.action: Day 1: for each plasmid (pSETGUS, pIJ12551) inoculate two independent 5 mL LB cultures (chloramphenicol 25 µg/mL, kanamycin 50 µg/mL, apramycin 100 µg/mL), each with three colonies of E. coli ET12567/pUZ8002 carrying the plasmid from the transformation plate. Incubate ~3 h at 37 °C, 250 rpm.
steps.source_quote: three colonies of E. coli ET12467/pUZ8002 with pSETGUS [43] or pIJ12551 [44,45] from the transformation plate was inoculated into 5 mL LB supplemented with chloramphenicol, kanamycin, and apramycin.
steps.note: Two cultures per plasmid are assumed so that 48 wells per plasmid can be filled.

steps.action: Add each 5 mL culture plus ~15 mL LB with the same antibiotics to a 50 mL Falcon tube (lid loosely tightened). Incubate ~18 h at 37 °C, 250 rpm to stationary phase (no OD target).
steps.source_quote: The cultures, with loosely tightened lids, were incubated at 37 °C, with 250 rpm orbital shaking for approx. 18 h and grown overnight to reach stationary state

steps.action: Day 2: pellet the E. coli (~4000 x g, 5-10 min, room temperature), wash twice with an equal volume of LB, and resuspend in 10% of the initial volume (10x concentrated) in the 50 mL tubes ecoli_pSETGUS_1/2 and ecoli_pIJ12551_1/2.
steps.source_quote: the user will wash the O/N culture two times with equal volume of LB media before resuspending it in 10 percent of the initial volume.
steps.note: Spin conditions are assumed (standard practice).

steps.action: Harvest spores of S. coelicolor M1152, S. coelicolor M1146, S. albidoflavus J1074 and S. venezuelae DSM40230 (grown on SFM at 30 °C until sporulated) into four 15 mL Falcon tubes using ~5 mL liquid. Adjust each to ~6.7x10^8 spores/mL in 2xYT so that 150 µL holds ~10^8 spores. Keep an aliquot for CFU estimation by serial dilution.
steps.source_quote: Next, the user will harvest the Streptomyces spores into 15 mL Falcon tubes using approx. 5 mL media.
steps.note: Spore counting and adjustment are assumed (Kieser 2000 standard practice; not fetched).

steps.action: Load the OT-2: empty 96-well deep-well plate conj_plate on slot 3; 50 mL tube rack with the E. coli tubes on slot 6; 15 mL tube rack with spore tubes on slot 9; 1000 µL tip box on slot 7; 300 µL tip box on slot 11. Use a single-channel 1000 µL pipette (E. coli) and a single-channel 300 µL pipette (spores). Start the protocol from the Opentrons GUI.
steps.source_quote: The user places the rack with 15 mL tubes with Streptomyces spores on deck position 9, tubes with the E. coli on deck position 6, the 96-well deep-well plates for the conjugation mix on deck position 3
steps.note: Layout: rows A-H = M1152+pSETGUS, M1152+pIJ12551, M1146+pSETGUS, M1146+pIJ12551, J1074+pSETGUS, J1074+pIJ12551, DSM40230+pSETGUS, DSM40230+pIJ12551; 12 replicates each (columns 1-12).

steps.note: Repeat-dispense with extra volume aspirated and no blow-out; one 1000 µL tip reused, up to 6 wells per aspiration.

steps.source_quote: This allowed us to use a 1000 μL tip for E. coli, enabling repeat-dispensing of six wells consecutively.
steps.note: Second tube of the same pSETGUS donor.

steps.source_quote: The OT-2 robot now mixes 150 μL of spores and 150 μL E. coli into the empty 96-well plates.
steps.note: Fresh 1000 µL tip for the second plasmid to avoid cross-contamination.

steps.source_quote: The 1000 μL tips aspirate and dispense the E. coli
steps.note: Second tube of the same pIJ12551 donor.

steps.source_quote: while the 300 μL tips aspirate and dispense Streptomyces spores
steps.note: New 300 µL tip per spore tube; no extra mixing described.

steps.source_quote: new pipette tips were used for the transfer of the Streptomyces, which is performed using the single pipetting head with individual 300 μL tips
approximately 108 Streptomyces spores in 150 μL 2xYT

steps.action: Streak the full 300 µL content of each conj_plate well onto its own 9 cm SFM agar plate containing 10 mM MgCl2 (96 plates). Incubate at 30 °C for 16-20 h.
steps.source_quote: plated onto SFM agar plates (supplemented to contain a final concentration of 10 mM MgCl2 (Sigma-Aldrich; M1028)), and incubated at 30 °C for 16–20 h.
steps.note: Spreading is done manually.

steps.action: Overlay each plate with 1 mL sterile water containing 0.5 mg nalidixic acid and the plasmid-specific selection antibiotic (apramycin, ~1 mg per plate). Dry in a sterile flow hood and incubate at 30 °C until exconjugant colonies appear (~3-5 days).
steps.source_quote: The plates were overlaid with 1 mL water containing 0.5 mg nalidixic acid and the plasmid specific selection antibiotic
steps.note: Apramycin amount and incubation time are assumed.

steps.action: Count exconjugant colonies on each plate. In parallel, estimate Streptomyces CFU per conjugation by 10-fold serial dilution of the spore suspension, plating on SFM without antibiotic and counting after 2-4 days at 30 °C. Efficiency = exconjugant CFU / estimated Streptomyces CFU. Pick exconjugants with sterile toothpicks onto SFM containing nalidixic acid and apramycin and incubate at 30 °C.
steps.source_quote: Conjugation efficiencies were calculated as the number of Streptomyces exconjugant CFUs divided by the estimated number of Streptomyces CFUs in the conjugation experiment (estimated by serial dilution).
steps.note: Dilution and plating details are assumed.

steps.source_quote: a pipette tip was used to suspend material from a single colony in 50 μL water in a 96-well PCR plate

steps.action: Suspend material from one picked exconjugant colony per well in lysate_plate, matching the conj_plate layout (rows A-H = the 8 combinations, 12 colonies each). Seal and incubate 20 min at 95 °C in a thermocycler.
steps.source_quote: incubated for 20 min in a thermocycler (Eppendorf A, Germany) at 95 °C.
steps.note: 12 PCRs per combination per the paper; one colony per replicate position is assumed.

steps.source_quote: boiled colony material 1 μL and H20 7 μL
steps.note: Master mix for 110 reactions (96 plus ~15% overage): 7 µL water per reaction.

steps.note: Paired well to well.

steps.action: Seal pcr_plate and run thermal cycling: 95 °C 3 min; 29 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 50 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 5 min. Then run the products on an agarose gel (1-1.5%) and score presence or absence of the apramycin-resistance amplicon per colony. False-positive rate = negative PCRs / total PCRs (12 per combination) x 100.
steps.source_quote: initial denaturation at 95 °C for 3 min, followed by 29 cycles consisting of denaturation at 95 °C for 30 s, annealing for 30 s at 50 °C, extension at 72 °C for 30 s, and a final extension step at 72 °C for 5 min.
steps.note: Gel conditions are assumed; the paper only reports bands present or absent.

assumptions: Strain naming: the methods give S. albidoflavus J1074 and the abstract/results give J1047. J1074 is used as the standard strain; J1047 is probably a typo.

Layout of the 96 conjugations (Table S3 not available): one deep-well plate, rows A-H = M1152+pSETGUS, M1152+pIJ12551, M1146+pSETGUS, M1146+pIJ12551, J1074+pSETGUS, J1074+pIJ12551, DSM40230+pSETGUS, DSM40230+pIJ12551; 12 replicates in columns 1-12. Each well receives 150 µL E. coli plus 150 µL spores (300 µL, within the 2000 µL well capacity).

Two 50 mL donor tubes per plasmid (four in total) are assumed so that 48 wells per plasmid (7.2 mL) can be filled. The paper states one concentrated culture serves ~31 conjugations. 5 mL concentrated culture per tube and 5 mL spore suspension per strain (needs 3.6 mL) are assumed, giving dead volume for repeat-dispensing.

Spore preparation (growth time, harvest, counting) is not described. It is assumed to follow Kieser 2000 (not fetched): confluent SFM lawn at 30 °C until sporulated, harvest in ~5 mL, count and adjust to ~6.7x10^8 spores/mL in 2xYT (~10^8 per 150 µL).
2xYT is assumed to be 16 g/L tryptone, 10 g/L yeast extract and 5 g/L NaCl, autoclaved (only tryptone is stated).

SFM composition: the paper omits the mannitol amount and agar %, and lists malt extract and glucose. 20 g/L soya flour, 20 g/L D-mannitol and 2% agar are assumed, plus 10 mM MgCl2 for conjugation plates (standard Kieser 2000 MS/SFM).
E. coli centrifugation (~4000 x g, 5-10 min, room temperature) is assumed. The wash with an equal volume of LB twice and resuspension in 10% of the initial volume are from the paper (s3.2.1).
The donor E. coli ET12567/pUZ8002 transformants (heat-shock transformation, s2.2/s3.2.1) are assumed to have been prepared beforehand, so the heat-shock robot run is not repeated here.

Liquid handling (OT-2 defaults): P1000 single-channel for E. coli with extra volume aspirated, repeat-dispensing 150 µL into up to 6 wells without blow-out, tips reused across E. coli transfers of the same plasmid; P300 single-channel with a fresh tip per Streptomyces tube. Mixing of the combined E. coli and spores is not described, so none is programmed. Deck layout follows s2.5/s3.2.1: conj_plate slot 3, E. coli tubes slot 6, spore tubes slot 9, 1000 µL tips slot 7, 300 µL tips slot 11.

Streaking of the full 300 µL well content onto 9 cm SFM + 10 mM MgCl2 plates, overlay, drying and incubation are manual, as in the paper. Apramycin amount in the overlay (~1 mg/plate), incubation time after overlay (3-5 days) and picking onto SFM with nalidixic acid (~25 µg/mL) and apramycin (50-100 µg/mL) are assumed standard practice.
Serial-dilution CFU estimation is not described in the paper. 10-fold dilutions plated on antibiotic-free SFM, counted after 2-4 days at 30 °C, are assumed.

Colony PCR: 12 PCRs per combination (stated) are assumed to be one colony per replicate position of the 96-well layout. The results text also says three colonies per experiment, which conflicts and is not resolved here. Master mix for 110 reactions (~15% overage) is assumed; per-reaction volumes are from s2.4 (1 µL buffer, 1 µL dNTPs, 0.5 µL of each primer, 0.025 µL polymerase, 7 µL water, 1 µL boiled colony). Master mix is dispensed at 9 µL per well before 1 µL template is added. Gel electrophoresis conditions are assumed.
Sources: no external sources could be fetched (Gren et al. 2021 and Kieser 2000 unavailable); all details come from the paper text, with gaps filled by standard practice.
The 96-well plate in s3.3.2 is read as one full plate (8 combinations x 12 replicates).
